sessionCookie.name: platform_session
sessionCookie.description: Proposed host-only Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; actual deployment name pending. Never JS storage.

path.description: Server-owned fixed relative path. Never an arbitrary client URL.

email_challenge_id.description: Authenticated account current pending email challenge, for continuing code entry after navigation. Not a verification secret.

password.description: ASCII English letters/digits/punctuation only; no whitespace; at least 1 uppercase letter and 2 punctuation occurrences (same punctuation may repeat). Common/account-similar passwords also rejected. Applies to new passwords; existing login credentials are preserved.

password_confirmation.description: ASCII English letters/digits/punctuation only; no whitespace; at least 1 uppercase letter and 2 punctuation occurrences (same punctuation may repeat). Common/account-similar passwords also rejected. Applies to new passwords; existing login credentials are preserved.

nickname.description: NFKC normalized; Korean/ASCII English/digits only, 2–10 characters, no whitespace; casefold uniqueness. Each character category is allowed, not mandatory. Empty signup value generates unique 회원####.

SignupInput.description: When email_consent=false, supplied email MUST be discarded before email validation, persistence or mail; UI omits it. real_name/gender/admin_role/is_staff not accepted. Signup atomically creates first membership; ordinary session is issued only after commit. Equality of passwords and policy publication checked server-side.

LoginInput.description: Ordinary member login only. Memberships/authority determined server-side. ADMIN requires existing separate primary+passkey flow.
